x-changelog.description:

invitation group on the response step: `responder` or `commenter`. Defaults to

in the workflow instance history response. Indicates the responsibility role of the
group on the response step: `responder` or `commenter`. Defaults to `responder` when
absent on legacy template data.

x-changelog.summary: Added is_continuable to action details in instance history (project)
x-changelog.description:
Added a nullable `is_continuable` field on action history rows at
`history[*].details.is_continuable` in the project-level workflow instance
history response. The field is populated only for the current action step to
indicate whether the action can be manually continued; otherwise it is null.

x-changelog.summary: Added action status and icon fields

- Added `history[*].details.status` for action execution state

x-changelog.summary: Add attachment id in instance history responses (project)
x-changelog.description:
Added `id` to attachment objects in response rows under
`history[*].details.responses[*].attachments[*]` for project-level workflow
instance history APIs.

x-changelog.summary: Instance history payload updates (roles location and additive fields)

`history[*].details.responses` (per-assignee response rows). Role assignment for the step is now
represented under `history[*].details.roles` on response-step events where applicable.

The instance history responses include significant additional data in the envelope and within
history events; clients should treat the contract as additive for unknown fields.
